forward_inputs.p3_roi: N65x9x9 floating original cached P3 including factual native support channel64. Preserve original dtype until model cast; no new quantization.
forward_inputs.local_rgb96: N3x96x96 uint8 unmarked original-q-centred source RGB crop, unchanged q/L and old bilinear recipe.
forward_inputs.local_valid96: N1x96x96 factual binary RGB canvas support; not semantic visibility.

output.query_logit: Exactly one finite scalar per original input q/crop. Positive class meaning NOT YET ADMITTED; source label contract must freeze it.
output.query_available: GT-free factual tensor support only. P3 native centre[4,4] and all four RGB96 cells bracketing nominal q (47:49,47:49) valid, plus some pool support. Not semantic U/confidence.
output.attention_diagnostic_only: N9x9. Never used as GT-region readout, localizer target, alternate output or label/coordinate selector.

same_operator_everywhere: Training loss, sourceVAL and prospective deployment read output[query_logit] directly. No GT-region lookup, argmax site, mosaic or chosen tile changes the scalar. Identical runtime/batch shape are required for exact FP32 repeat claims.
attention: Centre fused feature -> learned query8, each spatial fused feature -> key8, dot/sqrt8, factual-cell masked softmax. Relative offsets are fixed input-grid offsets to original q, not GT coordinates. Weighted sum24 + centre24 + supportfraction1 -> MLP49/16/1.
pool_support: P3 native support & adaptive-averaged RGB support>0. Invalid pixel values are zeroed before encoders, pool excludes factual invalid cells. Empty support attention=0.
loss_draft_only: BCEWithLogits directly on same scalar; known label 0/1 & query_available only, unweighted admitted mean, empty graphzero. Unknown labels and known unavailable rows never become negative examples. All rows must remain in downstream reports; source gate denominator/abstention penalty/selector/sampler/budget are NOT established by this draft.
decode_draft: Sign: logit>=0 -> binary1, logit<0 -> binary0; unavailable -> -1 U. Rounded sigmoid is display-only. This draft assigns no D/E/S name to binary classes.
prior_factual_flags: A future data protocol must preserve original q/L/order/producer-valid/MISS/absent-candidate flags separately and use the same GT-free output availability gate at train/VAL/deployment. This model cannot infer q continuous-valid metadata not present in its three tensors.
initialization: Generated random encoders/fusion/query/key/MLP; final scalar linear is zero. No checkpoint read/load/transfer executed. Any future V91/V88 transfer must be separately frozen and checked.
pending_before_source_or_fit: Actual initializer q/L availability and expected target/cue operational binding.
